# core-v1_branch_status_response (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `branch_name` (String) The name of the branch that the EDA instance is running within.  This only has a value when
mode is branch.
- `main_cluster` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--main_cluster))
- `mode` (String) Indication of the mode of the EDA instance to which the request is made.
It is "main" if running in the main/production cluster, and "branch" if running in a branch cluster.

<a id="nestedatt--main_cluster"></a>
### Nested Schema for `main_cluster`

Read-Only:

- `domain_name` (String) The external domain name of the main/production cluster
- `https_port` (Number) HTTPS port used to reach the main/production cluster externally
- `ipv4_address` (String) The external IPv4 address of the main/production cluster
- `ipv6_address` (String) The external IPv6 address of the main/production cluster
